supported_finding.title: Berlin immigration portal points to district welfare-association advice centres for language courses, official paperwork and securing residence

publication_decision: Hold as supporting research. Municipal signposting does not identify a particular independent offering or establish employment-advice capability, eligibility, fees or contact details. No map objects or relationships added.
next_source_route: Follow the captured official welfare-association directory PDF link to verify named centres and their exact access conditions. Preserve the query string from the captured link; do not treat a grouped follow-up target as a fetch URL.
media_decision: Berlin portal logo and composite welfare-association logos are not a verified single offering identity. None promoted.
